archTIS Wins U.S. Regional Bank Contract 2
										
                                            pages 92.9KB

analysis.what_happened: archTIS secured a A$119K contract with a Nasdaq-listed U.S. regional bank to deploy its Spirion Sensitive Data Platform for data retention and lifecycle management, the second Spirion win in two weeks totalling A$564K in combined contract value.
analysis.so_what: Deals are small (A$564K TCV in two weeks) but demonstrate early commercial traction for Spirion outside government/defence into financial services, validating the acquisition thesis and opening upsell opportunities into NC Protect and TDI — material to growth narrative but immaterial to near-term revenue.
